answer: SELECT p.ID,p.SEX,(CAST(strftime('%Y','2026-10-09') AS INT)-CAST(strftime('%Y',p.Birthday) AS INT)-(strftime('%m-%d','2026-10-09')<strftime('%m-%d',p.Birthday))) AS age FROM Patient p WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE GLU>=180 AND "T-CHO"<250) ORDER BY p.ID

SELECT p.ID,(CAST(strftime('%Y','2026-10-09') AS INT)-CAST(strftime('%Y',p.Birthday) AS INT)-(strftime('%m-%d','2026-10-09')<strftime('%m-%d',p.Birthday))) AS age FROM Patient p WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE HCT>=52 GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(*)>=2) ORDER BY p.ID
SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(Admission LIKE '+%')/COUNT(*),2) AS pct FROM Patient WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31' AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory)

WITH RECURSIVE dx(ID,tok,rest) AS (SELECT ID,'',replace(replace(replace(replace(Diagnosis,char(29),','),char(11),','),'  ',','),', ',',')||',' FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT ID,trim(substr(rest,1,instr(rest,',')-1)),substr(rest,instr(rest,',')+1) FROM dx WHERE rest<>''), d AS (SELECT ID,tok FROM dx WHERE tok<>'') SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Patient p WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM d WHERE d.ID=p.ID)=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d WHERE d.ID=p.ID AND tok='MCTD') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID=p.ID AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID=p.ID AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)>5)

WITH RECURSIVE dx(ID,tok,rest) AS (SELECT ID,'',replace(replace(replace(replace(Diagnosis,char(29),','),char(11),','),'  ',','),', ',',')||',' FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT ID,trim(substr(rest,1,instr(rest,',')-1)),substr(rest,instr(rest,',')+1) FROM dx WHERE rest<>''), d AS (SELECT ID,tok FROM dx WHERE tok<>''), g AS (SELECT p.ID FROM Patient p WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM d WHERE d.ID=p.ID)=2 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d WHERE d.ID=p.ID AND tok='RA') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d WHERE d.ID=p.ID AND tok='SJS')), n AS (SELECT g.ID, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID=g.ID AND l.PLT>100 AND l.PLT<400) AS ok FROM g) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ok),0) AS with_normal, COALESCE(SUM(1-ok),0) AS never_normal FROM n

WITH t AS (SELECT p.ID, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) m FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID=p.ID WHERE p.SEX='F' AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.ID) SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(m>64)/COUNT(*),2) AS pct FROM t
SELECT AVG(1999-CAST(strftime('%Y',Birthday) AS INT)) AS avg_age FROM Patient WHERE Birthday IS NOT NULL AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3','4','300','>=300','>=1000'))
SELECT MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y',l.Date) AS INT)-CAST(strftime('%Y',p.Birthday) AS INT)) AS youngest_age FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID=l.ID WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)>=64

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Patient p WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID=p.ID AND l.SSA IS NOT NULL AND l.SSA NOT IN ('negative','0')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID=p.ID AND l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND l."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-','0'))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Patient p WHERE p.Birthday>'1980-01-01' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID=p.ID AND (l.FG<150 OR l.FG>450)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID=p.ID AND l."U-PRO" IN ('3','4','300','>=300','>=1000')))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Patient p WHERE p.SEX='F' AND p.Admission LIKE '+%' AND p.Birthday BETWEEN '1945-01-01' AND '1989-12-31' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Examination e WHERE e.ID=p.ID AND e."ANA Pattern"='P')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS n FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID=p.ID WHERE p.SEX='F' AND l.PT<14 AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)>=16

WITH RECURSIVE dx(ID,tok,rest) AS (SELECT ID,'',replace(replace(replace(replace(Diagnosis,char(29),','),char(11),','),'  ',','),', ',',')||',' FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT ID,trim(substr(rest,1,instr(rest,',')-1)),substr(rest,instr(rest,',')+1) FROM dx WHERE rest<>''), d AS (SELECT ID,tok FROM dx WHERE tok<>'') SELECT p.ID,p.SEX FROM Patient p WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d WHERE d.ID=p.ID AND tok IN ('SLE','SLE (diffuse LE)')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID=p.ID AND l."T-BIL">=1.2) ORDER BY p.SEX,p.ID

WITH RECURSIVE dx(ID,tok,rest) AS (SELECT ID,'',replace(replace(replace(replace(Diagnosis,char(29),','),char(11),','),'  ',','),', ',',')||',' FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT ID,trim(substr(rest,1,instr(rest,',')-1)),substr(rest,instr(rest,',')+1) FROM dx WHERE rest<>''), d AS (SELECT ID,tok FROM dx WHERE tok<>''), s AS (SELECT p.ID,p.Diagnosis,l.DNA FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID=p.ID WHERE l.DNA IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d WHERE d.ID=p.ID AND tok IN ('SLE','SLE (diffuse LE)'))) SELECT ID,Diagnosis,DNA AS max_dna FROM s WHERE CAST(DNA AS REAL)=(SELECT MAX(CAST(DNA AS REAL)) FROM s)

WITH RECURSIVE dx(ID,tok,rest) AS (SELECT ID,'',replace(replace(replace(replace(Diagnosis,char(29),','),char(11),','),'  ',','),', ',',')||',' FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT ID,trim(substr(rest,1,instr(rest,',')-1)),substr(rest,instr(rest,',')+1) FROM dx WHERE rest<>''), d AS (SELECT ID,tok FROM dx WHERE tok<>'') SELECT ROUND(AVG(e."aCL IgM"),2) AS avg_igm FROM Examination e WHERE e."aCL IgM">0 AND e.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM d WHERE tok='SJS')

SELECT ROUND(AVG(a),1) AS avg_age FROM (SELECT p.ID,(CAST(strftime('%Y','2026-10-09') AS INT)-CAST(strftime('%Y',p.Birthday) AS INT)-(strftime('%m-%d','2026-10-09')<strftime('%m-%d',p.Birthday))) a FROM Patient p WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL)>=64)) WHERE a<70

SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(SEX='F')/COUNT(*),1) AS pct_women FROM Patient WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1936-01-01' AND '1956-12-31' AND SEX IN ('F','M') AND ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE CPK>=250)
